title: multi check's coord-store and output-log refusals each have a planted check, not only the canary one
goal: a planted run with one non-lookup agent's coord store removed and one with a kb agent's output log removed each make multi check exit 2 naming it, run as checks, so deleting either branch of unreadable fails a check (reviewer of SP-p46hofrg on ST-prrja362: its check removes only the scratch canaries)

run:
import glob, json, os, sqlite3, subprocess, sys, tempfile
D = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='rv-', dir=os.environ.get('TMPDIR', '/tmp'))
b = lambda *a: subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/benchmarks.py', 'multi', *a, '--dir', D], capture_output=True, text=True)
b('run', 'mixed', '--replay')
for p in sorted(glob.glob(D + '/coord/*/coord.sqlite'))[:1] + sorted(glob.glob(D + '/output/agent*.log'))[:1]:
    os.rename(p, p + '.away')
    r = b('check')
    os.rename(p + '.away', p)
    assert r.returncode == 2, ('multi check does not refuse a run missing', p, r.returncode)
b('remove')
